units.source_text: 的确，北山杉树的枝丫一直修整到树梢。

en.t: Indeed, the branches of the Kitayama cedars had been trimmed all the way to their tips.

units.source_text: 在千重子看来，呈圆形残留在树梢上的叶子，就像是一朵朵淡雅的冬天的绿花。

en.t: To Chieko, the leaves left in round clusters at the treetops looked like delicate green flowers of winter.
